configure_robot_viz: configure robot visualization by creating SRV plots for each device's sensor and actuator names
update_robot_viz: update robot visualization by appending new sensor data or actuator control data to SRV plots
clear_robot_viz: clear robot visualization by removing sensor or actuator data from SRV plots
review_robot_viz: review the robot_viz module to understand how SRV plots are configured, updated, and cleared for robot devices
summarize_robot_viz: summarize the robot_viz module which provides SRV-based visualization for robot sensor and actuator data
